prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right lawyer depends on your case details (how serious your injuries are, who was at fault, insurance issues, whether you want to sue or settle, your budget and timeline). I can’t name one definitive lawyer, but I can help you find the best one for your situation. Here’s how to choose and next steps.

How to pick the right Houston car-wreck lawyer
- Look for experience with car-accident and bodily-injury cases (not general practice). Prefer lawyers who handle similar severity (minor soft-tissue vs. catastrophic injuries).
- Trial experience: many cases settle, but choose a lawyer who will take a case to trial if needed.
- Track record: past settlements/verdicts in comparable cases are a useful indicator (but past results don’t guarantee future results).
- Communication and team: who will actually handle your case (attorney vs. paralegal)? How often will you get updates?
- Fee structure: most PI lawyers work on contingency (no fee unless you recover). Confirm the percentage and whether costs are deducted from recovery.
- Local reputation: check client reviews and peer ratings (Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Avvo, Google).
- Licensing & discipline: verify the lawyer’s standing with the State Bar of Texas.

Immediate practical steps
1. Get medical treatment and preserve records.
2. Gather crash evidence: police report, photos, contact info for other driver/witnesses, vehicle damage, medical bills.
3. Don’t give recorded statements to insurers without an attorney present.
4. Contact 3–5 lawyers for free consultations and compare answers.

Questions to ask in the free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Have you handled cases with injuries like mine?
- Who will handle my file day-to-day?
- What’s your fee and how are costs handled?
- What’s a realistic range for settlement in cases like mine?
- How long will this likely take?
- Can you provide references or recent case results?

Where to search for strong candidates
- State Bar of Texas (verify license and discipline history)
- Super Lawyers and Martindale-Hubbell (peer reviews)
- Google Reviews, Avvo, and local Facebook groups
- Referrals from friends, family, or medical providers

If you want, I can:
- Search for top-rated Houston personal injury lawyers near your ZIP code (tell me your ZIP or neighborhood), or
- Draft a short script/email you can use to contact lawyers, or
- Prepare a checklist for the first meeting.

Which would you like to do next?
